COLDWAR_ISR_ai_historical_path = {
	is_historical_focus_on = yes

COLDWAR_ISR_ai_not_historical_path = {
	is_historical_focus_on = no
}

# peace with Egypt: MD peace system (COLDWAR_EGY peace flag) or our own treaty, and no war
COLDWAR_ISR_peace_with_egypt = {
	country_exists = EGY
	NOT = { has_war_with = EGY }
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_peace_egypt
		has_country_flag = ISR70_egypt_peace_signed
		EGY = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EGY_peace_with_israel }
	}
}

# partner scope: the pair partner/Israel is clear (no war, no native embargo, none of the Imperia sanction arrays in either direction)
COLDWAR_ISR_pair_clear = {
	country_exists = ISR
	NOT = { has_war_with = ISR }
	NOT = { is_embargoed_by = ISR }
	ISR = { NOT = { is_embargoed_by = PREV } }
	NOT = {
		OR = {
			is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = ISR }
			is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = ISR }
			is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = ISR }
			is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = ISR }
			is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = ISR }
			is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = ISR }
			is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = ISR }
			is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = ISR }
		}
	}
}

			country_exists = ETH
			ETH = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_psigned_mashav COLDWAR_ISR_pair_clear = yes }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_deal_active_back_channel = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_deal_back_channel_JOR
			country_exists = JOR
			JOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_psigned_back_channel COLDWAR_ISR_pair_clear = yes }
		}
	}
}
